2026-12-12.title: Saturday of the Second Week of Advent · Our Lady of Guadalupe
readings: Elijah, a prophet like fire, will return
Lord, make us turn to you; let us see your face and we shall be saved
Elijah has already come, and they did not recognize him
2026-12-12.alt: Optional memorial of Our Lady of Guadalupe (a feast in the Americas, with proper readings: Zechariah 2:14–17 or Revelation 11:19a; 12:1–6a, 10ab; Luke 1:26–38 or 1:39–47).
2026-12-12.verse: I tell you that Elijah has already come, and they did not recognize him, but they did to him whatever they pleased.
theo: Sirach praises Elijah: “a prophet like fire, and his word burned like a torch”. Taken up in a whirlwind, he is destined to return “to turn the hearts of parents to their children, and to restore the tribes of Jacob” (cf. Malachi 4:5–6). Coming down from the mountain of the Transfiguration, the disciples ask about this. Jesus answers that Elijah has already come, in John the Baptist, “and they did not recognize him”; the Son of Man too will suffer.

Today the Church in the Americas honours Our Lady of Guadalupe, who appeared in 1531 to St Juan Diego near Mexico City, as a young mestiza woman speaking his language, leaving her image on his cloak (tilma). Within a few years millions of indigenous people were baptised. Like Elijah, like John, Mary prepares the way for Christ and turns hearts. Her image shows her pregnant: Advent in a picture, carrying Christ to a whole people.

2026-12-12.prayer: Lord God, you sent Elijah and John to prepare your way, and Mary to bring your Son to every people. Turn my heart to you and to my family, and let me recognise your messengers. Amen.
altar: At Mass we stand with Mary and all the prophets before the One they announced. The fire of the Spirit comes upon the gifts and upon us.

quick: Elijah was a prophet like fire.
Elijah returned in John, and many did not recognise him.

2026-12-12.question: Do I recognise the messengers God sends me?

family.explain: Elijah spoke God's word like fire. He helped parents and children love each other again. Mary, Our Lady of Guadalupe, loves all mothers and children.
family.intention: We pray for mothers and unborn babies.
family.ask: Ask: “How can parents and children in our family spend more time together?”

pm.open: Lord God, you sent Elijah, John and Mary to prepare the way for your Son. As we gather, turn our hearts to you and to one another. Amen.
share: Elijah's word burned like a torch (Sirach 48:1). What word of God burns in my heart?
Jesus says they did not recognise Elijah (Matthew 17:12). Whom do I fail to recognise as God's messenger?
How can I turn my heart more to my family?
pm.resp: Our Lady of Guadalupe, pray for us.
interc: For the Church, that she may speak God's truth with fire and tenderness.
For mothers and unborn children, through the prayers of Our Lady of Guadalupe.
For families where parents and children are distant, that their hearts may be turned.
For indigenous and tribal peoples, that they may be respected.
For our group, that we may recognise God's messengers in our lives.
pm.close: Lord God, through Our Lady of Guadalupe you showed a mother's love to the poor. Turn the hearts of parents to their children, and prepare us to welcome your Son. Amen.

illus: A father in Bengaluru, always working late, decided one Advent to be home for dinner every evening. His teenage daughter, who had stopped talking to him, slowly began to share her day again. He said: “Elijah turned my heart to my child.”

homily: Dear friends, Sirach remembers the prophet Elijah: then Elijah arose, a prophet like fire, and his word burned like a torch (Sirach 48:1). He was taken up in a whirlwind of fire, and the tradition said he would return to turn the hearts of parents to their children (Sirach 48:9–10).

In the Gospel, as they come down from the mountain of the Transfiguration, the disciples ask Jesus about Elijah. Jesus answers: Elijah has already come, and they did not recognise him, but did to him whatever they pleased. Then the disciples understood that he was speaking about John the Baptist (Matthew 17:10–13).
John came in the spirit and power of Elijah. Both were men of fire: they spoke the truth whatever the cost. Both called the people back to God. Both suffered for it.

Today is also the feast of Our Lady of Guadalupe. In 1531 Mary appeared to a poor indigenous man, St Juan Diego, near Mexico City, as a young mother, dressed like his own people, expecting a child (T). Through her, millions came to faith. She is patroness of the Americas and of the unborn.
Elijah and John prepared the way by fiery words; Mary at Guadalupe prepared the way with a mother's tenderness. God uses both fire and gentleness to turn hearts.

Elijah was to turn the hearts of parents to their children. This is a great need today: parents too busy for their children, children too distant from their parents. This Advent, let us turn our hearts to our families: time, attention, forgiveness. And let us ask Our Lady of Guadalupe to protect all mothers and their unborn children. Amen.
kids: Children, Mary appeared to a poor man named Juan Diego and spoke his language. Mary loves every people and every child!

intro: Elijah's fire, John's unrecognised coming, and Mary who carries Christ to a people.

sub: He was taken up in a whirlwind.
He would return to prepare the way.
q: Then Elijah arose, a prophet like fire, and his word burned like a torch.

With the spirit and power of Elijah he will go before him, to turn the hearts of parents to their children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous, to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.
points.apply: Ask the Holy Spirit to set your words on fire for good.

sub: The Son of Man too will suffer.
q: Lo, I will send you the prophet Elijah before the great and terrible day of the LORD comes. He will turn the hearts of parents to their children and the hearts of children to their parents, so that I will not come and strike the land with a curse.

He replied, “Elijah is indeed coming and will restore all things; but I tell you that Elijah has already come, and they did not recognize him, but they did to him whatever they pleased. So also the Son of Man is about to suffer at their hands.”
points.apply: Reconcile with a family member before Christmas.

sub: She came to the humble Juan Diego.
Her image shows her with child.
She carries Christ to a whole people.
q: When they met her, they all blessed her with one accord and said to her, “You are the glory of Jerusalem, you are the great boast of Israel, you are the great pride of our nation!”
A great portent appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.
points.apply: Pray the Rosary for unborn children.

concl: God sends messengers to turn our hearts.
Mary brings Christ to us this Advent.
2026-12-12.resolve: Pray for the protection of unborn children this Advent.
